business_summary: TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, buying, and sale of men's and women's apparel, accessories, and other products in Japan. The company operates under store brands, such as UNITED ARROWS, BEAUTY&YOUTH UNITED ARROWS, UNITED ARROWS green label relaxing, DRAWER, BLAMINK, conte, H BEAUTY&YOUTH, ASTRAET, UNITED ARROWS & SONS, 6, steven alan, monkey time, ODETTE E ODILE, ATTISESSION, CITEN, NICE WEATHER, California General Store, UNITED ARROWS Golf, and OSOI brands. It also offers products under LOEFF, Pheeta, AEWEN MATOPH, SOVEREIGN, EMMEL REFINES, PREEK, MARW, SY, TO, Lepidos, TABAYA, UNITED ARROWS BEAUTY, and District UNITED ARROWS labels, as well as UNITED ARROWS outlets. The company was formerly known as United Arrows Ltd. and changed its name to TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2026. TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
